item.subject: Mathematics
item.stem:
On the grid below, draw the reflection of the shape in the dotted line of symmetry.

[Image: Grid with a polygon and a dashed line of symmetry]

descriptors: One or more of image lines drawn correctly, but image not completely correct
Attempt to sketch an image under a transformation other than reflection (e.g., translation of image)
Other incorrect (including crossed out/erased, stray marks, illegible, or off task)

item.figure_description:
An 8 by 8 grid of square cells with a vertical dashed line of symmetry running along the central vertical grid line (between the 4th and 5th columns from the left).
To the right of the dashed line is a six-sided polygon with vertices at grid intersections (with column lines 0 to 8 from left to right, and row lines 0 to 8 from top to bottom):
- (column 4, row 3) on the dashed line
- (column 5, row 2)
- (column 6, row 4)
- (column 7, row 4)
- (column 7, row 6)
- (column 4, row 5) on the dashed line

The edges of the polygon connect these vertices in sequence:
- A straight segment from (4, 3) up and right to (5, 2)
- A segment from (5, 2) down and right to (6, 4)
- A horizontal segment from (6, 4) to (7, 4)
- A vertical segment from (7, 4) down to (7, 6)
- A slanted segment from (7, 6) up and left to (4, 5)
- A vertical segment of length 2 along the dashed line from (4, 5) up to (4, 3)

slope.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 1-point item with the two-parameter logistic (2PL) model, which TIMSS uses for constructed-response items worth 1 point, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2003 data, 2007 bridging data, and 2007 data (fourth-grade mathematics)". What is the item's slope (discrimination) parameter a? A higher a means that the item separates students of lower and higher mathematics ability more sharply. Choose the value closest to it.

location.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 1-point item with the two-parameter logistic (2PL) model, which TIMSS uses for constructed-response items worth 1 point, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2003 data, 2007 bridging data, and 2007 data (fourth-grade mathematics)". What is the item's location (difficulty) parameter b? b is on a logit scale on which the students of the calibration average about 0; a higher b means a harder item. Choose the value closest to it.
